blocks.zh: 無菌處理醫療保健產品 — 第二部分：滅菌過濾
blocks.en: Aseptic Processing of Health Care Products — Part 2: Sterilizing Filtration

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解無菌過濾（Sterilizing Filtration）的本質與限制，以及為何無法使用 SAL 表達無菌保證
blocks.en: Understand the nature and limitations of sterilizing filtration, and why sterility assurance cannot be expressed as an SAL

blocks.zh: 掌握 0.2 µm 過濾的標準驗證挑戰菌（Brevundimonas diminuta）及 0.1 µm 對 Mycoplasma 的特殊要求
blocks.en: Master the standard validation challenge organism for 0.2 µm filtration (Brevundimonas diminuta) and the special requirements for Mycoplasma at 0.1 µm

blocks.zh: 學習過濾器完整性測試（Filter Integrity Test）的原理、方法類型及 PUPSIT 的合規要求
blocks.en: Learn the principles and method types of the filter integrity test, and the compliance requirements for PUPSIT

blocks.zh: 理解過濾器相容性（化學相容性、萃出物/浸出物、吸附）對生物製劑的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Understand the special challenges that filter compatibility (chemical compatibility, extractables/leachables, adsorption) poses for biologics

blocks.zh: 建立完整的過濾驗證程式設計能力，包括生物負荷控制、序列/冗餘過濾設計
blocks.en: Build the ability to design a complete filtration validation program, including bioburden control and series/redundant filtration design

blocks.zh: Clause 1–4: Scope, Definitions, and Quality System Clause 1–4：適用範圍、定義與品質系統
blocks.en: Clause 1–4: Scope, Definitions, and Quality System

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：無菌過濾的本質與 SAL 的侷限
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Nature of Sterilizing Filtration and the Limits of SAL

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌（如高壓蒸汽）的殺菌動力學遵循對數曲線，可外推計算 SAL（如 10⁻⁶）。但過濾是物理攔截，並非殺滅。
blocks.en: The kill kinetics of terminal sterilization (e.g. steam) follow a logarithmic curve, so an SAL (e.g. 10⁻⁶) can be calculated by extrapolation. Filtration, however, is physical retention, not killing.

blocks.zh: 過濾膜不能保證 100% 攔截（尤其是接近孔徑大小的微生物），且濾膜受損就完全失效。因此：
blocks.en: A filter membrane cannot guarantee 100% retention (especially of organisms close to the pore size), and it fails completely if the membrane is damaged. Therefore:

blocks.zh: 無菌過濾不能用 SAL 值表達可靠性
blocks.en: Sterilizing filtration cannot express its reliability as an SAL value

blocks.zh: 可靠性必須通過：過濾器驗證（菌挑戰測試） + 完整性測試（每批）
blocks.en: Reliability must be demonstrated through filter validation (bacterial challenge test) + integrity testing (every batch)

blocks.zh: 過濾後的整個系統無菌維持同樣關鍵
blocks.en: Maintaining sterility throughout the entire system downstream of the filter is equally critical

blocks.zh: 重要提示：供應商變更通知義務
blocks.en: Key Point: Supplier Change Notification Obligation

blocks.zh: 第 4.3.2 條要求過濾器供應商在任何可能影響性能的製造工藝變更時通知用戶。這是為什麼你必須：
blocks.en: Clause 4.3.2 requires the filter supplier to notify the user of any manufacturing process change that may affect performance. This is why you must:

blocks.zh: 與過濾器供應商簽訂品質協議（Quality Agreement）
blocks.en: Sign a Quality Agreement with the filter supplier

blocks.zh: 協議中明確列出觸發通知的變更類型（膜材料、孔徑、製造設施等）
blocks.en: List in the agreement the types of change that trigger notification (membrane material, pore size, manufacturing site, etc.)

blocks.zh: 建立供應商變更評估程序，判斷是否需要重新驗證
blocks.en: Establish a supplier change assessment procedure to determine whether revalidation is needed

blocks.zh: 這一要求在多起藥品召回事件中都扮演了重要角色——供應商悄悄改變了過濾器材料，導致產品中出現未預期的浸出物。
blocks.en: This requirement has played an important role in several drug recalls, in which a supplier quietly changed the filter material and unexpected leachables appeared in the product.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：過濾器就像咖啡濾紙
blocks.en: Analogy: A Filter Is Like a Coffee Filter Paper

blocks.zh: 0.2 µm 過濾器就像超精密咖啡濾紙：可以過濾掉細菌（咖啡渣），但如果濾紙破了一個洞（完整性失敗），所有渣都會通過。因此「濾紙完好性」的確認（完整性測試）比過濾行為本身更關鍵。而且你需要用被過濾的液體（咖啡），而不是清水，來做挑戰測試。
blocks.en: A 0.2 µm filter is like an ultra-precise coffee filter paper: it can hold back bacteria (the coffee grounds), but if the paper has a hole (integrity failure), all the grounds pass through. So confirming the integrity of the paper (the integrity test) matters more than the act of filtering itself. And you need to run the challenge test with the liquid actually being filtered (the coffee), not with plain water.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISO 13408-2 明確說明「不適用於病毒去除」？去除病毒的過濾有哪些不同的驗證要求？
blocks.en: Why does ISO 13408-2 explicitly state that it is "not applicable to virus removal"? How do the validation requirements for virus-removal filtration differ?

blocks.zh: 供應商通知義務（4.3.2）在實際執行上如何落實？你的 QA 系統應有哪些機制來接收和評估此類通知？
blocks.en: How is the supplier notification obligation (4.3.2) implemented in practice? What mechanisms should your QA system have to receive and assess such notifications?

blocks.zh: Clauses 5–9: Filter Characterization, Process Definition, and Validation Clauses 5–9：過濾器特性描述、製程定義與驗證
blocks.en: Clauses 5–9: Filter Characterization, Process Definition, and Validation

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何是 Brevundimonas diminuta？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Brevundimonas diminuta?

blocks.zh: Brevundimonas diminuta（過去稱 Pseudomonas diminuta）是 0.2 µm 過濾驗證的標準挑戰菌，因為：
blocks.en: Brevundimonas diminuta (formerly Pseudomonas diminuta) is the standard challenge organism for 0.2 µm filter validation, because:

blocks.zh: 體積極小（約 0.3-0.4 µm），是已知最小的非孢子形成革蘭氏陰性菌之一
blocks.en: It is extremely small (about 0.3-0.4 µm), one of the smallest known non-spore-forming Gram-negative bacteria

blocks.zh: 培養條件會影響細胞大小（飢餓條件下更小），可產生「最差條件」挑戰
blocks.en: Culture conditions affect cell size (smaller under starvation conditions), which allows a "worst-case" challenge to be produced

blocks.zh: 通過特定培養可產生具有挑戰性的細胞大小（ASTM F838-15 方法）
blocks.en: Specific culture conditions can produce a challenging cell size (ASTM F838-15 method)

blocks.zh: 關鍵警示：如果你的產品生物負荷中含有比 B. diminuta 更小的微生物（如某些 Mycoplasma），必須更換挑戰菌！
blocks.en: Critical warning: if the bioburden of your product contains organisms smaller than B. diminuta (such as certain Mycoplasma), you must change the challenge organism!

blocks.zh: 過濾驗證程式設計 Filtration Validation Programme
blocks.en: Filtration Validation Programme

blocks.zh:
過濾器驗證的四個主要組件：

1. 微生物攔截驗證（Microbial Retention）
   挑戰菌：B. diminuta (0.2µm) 或 A. laidlawii (0.1µm)
   挑戰量：≥1×10⁷ CFU/cm²
   過濾器批次：≥3批，連續3次成功
   條件：最差工藝條件（壓差、溫度、流速上限）

2. 完整性測試相關性（Integrity Test Correlation）
   - 建立細菌攔截 vs 物理完整性的相關性
   - 設定生產過濾器的完整性測試規格（如泡點/前進流量限值）

3. 過濾器-流體相容性（Filter-Fluid Compatibility）
   - 化學相容性（過濾器材料不被溶解）
   - 浸出物（Leachables）：生產條件下
   - 萃出物（Extractables）：極端條件下
   - 吸附（Adsorption）：產品成分損失

4. 過濾系統滅菌驗證
   - SIP（就地滅菌）或高壓滅菌器滅菌
   - 滅菌循環對過濾器性能的影響
blocks.en:
The four main components of filter validation:

1. Microbial retention validation
   Challenge organism: B. diminuta (0.2µm) or A. laidlawii (0.1µm)
   Challenge level: ≥1×10⁷ CFU/cm²
   Filter lots: ≥3 lots, 3 consecutive successes
   Conditions: worst-case process conditions (upper limits of differential pressure, temperature, flow rate)

2. Integrity test correlation
   - Establish the correlation between bacterial retention and physical integrity
   - Set the integrity test specification for production filters (e.g. bubble point / forward flow limits)

3. Filter-fluid compatibility
   - Chemical compatibility (filter material is not dissolved)
   - Leachables: under production conditions
   - Extractables: under extreme conditions
   - Adsorption: loss of product components

4. Filtration system sterilization validation
   - Sterilization by SIP (sterilization-in-place) or autoclave
   - Effect of the sterilization cycle on filter performance

blocks.zh: PUPSIT — 使用前滅菌後完整性測試
blocks.en: PUPSIT — Pre-Use Post-Sterilization Integrity Test

blocks.zh: PUPSIT（Pre-Use Post-Sterilization Integrity Test）是 EU GMP Annex 1 (2022) 的強制要求，ISO 13408-2 也明確支持（8.4.2）。
blocks.en: PUPSIT (Pre-Use Post-Sterilization Integrity Test) is a mandatory requirement of EU GMP Annex 1 (2022), and ISO 13408-2 also explicitly supports it (8.4.2).

blocks.zh: PUPSIT 的目的：確認過濾器在滅菌過程（如 SIP）中沒有受損。這是對高壓蒸汽滅菌可能造成濾膜機械損傷的預防。
blocks.en: The purpose of PUPSIT: to confirm that the filter was not damaged during the sterilization process (e.g. SIP). It guards against the mechanical damage to the membrane that steam sterilization can cause.

blocks.zh: 挑戰：PUPSIT 操作本身引入污染風險（需要潤濕測試液、連接儀器）。因此必須有經過驗證的 PUPSIT 程序，確保測試過程不破壞下游無菌性。
blocks.en: The challenge: the PUPSIT operation itself introduces a contamination risk (wetting with test fluid and connecting instruments are required). A validated PUPSIT procedure is therefore needed to ensure the test does not compromise downstream sterility.

blocks.zh: 不做 PUPSIT 的前提：必須有風險評估支持，並說明替代控制措施（如 HCF 是否接受）。FDA 通常期望 PUPSIT，省略需要強有力的科學依據。
blocks.en: Prerequisite for not performing PUPSIT: it must be supported by a risk assessment, with alternative control measures explained (and whether the regulator accepts them). The FDA generally expects PUPSIT, and omitting it requires strong scientific justification.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：出門前檢查安全帶
blocks.en: Analogy: Checking the Seat Belt Before You Leave

blocks.zh: PUPSIT 就像在每次出行前檢查安全帶是否完好（而不只是在事故後才檢查）。過濾器滅菌（SIP 或高壓）就像拉緊安全帶——這個動作本身可能損壞某些部件。出發前確認安全帶正常（PUPSIT），比在終點發現它早就斷了（後使用完整性測試失敗）要好得多，因為那時候已經充填了整批產品。
blocks.en: PUPSIT is like checking that the seat belt is intact before every trip (rather than only after an accident). Filter sterilization (SIP or autoclave) is like pulling the seat belt tight: this action itself may damage some components. Confirming the belt is fine before departure (PUPSIT) is much better than discovering at the destination that it broke long ago (post-use integrity test failure), because by then the whole batch has already been filled.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：生物製劑的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Practical Application: Special Challenges of Biologics

blocks.zh: 單株抗體（mAb）等生物製劑在過濾驗證中的特殊挑戰：
blocks.en: Special challenges in filtration validation for biologics such as monoclonal antibodies (mAbs):

blocks.zh: 高黏度：高濃度 mAb（>100 mg/mL）黏度高，過濾壓差大，增加過濾時間
blocks.en: High viscosity: high-concentration mAbs (>100 mg/mL) are viscous, causing a high differential pressure across the filter and longer filtration times

blocks.zh: 吸附：蛋白質可能吸附在 PVDF 或 PES 濾膜上，導致濃度損失或 Fc 效應喪失
blocks.en: Adsorption: proteins may adsorb onto PVDF or PES membranes, causing loss of concentration or loss of Fc effector function

blocks.zh: 抗菌特性：某些抗菌肽類藥物會殺死 B. diminuta，使挑戰菌試驗無效，需要使用「模擬液」
blocks.en: Antimicrobial properties: some antimicrobial peptide drugs kill B. diminuta, invalidating the challenge test and requiring the use of a "surrogate fluid"

blocks.zh: 顆粒：高濃度蛋白質聚合體可能堵塞過濾器，影響過濾能力（filter capacity）
blocks.en: Particles: high-concentration protein aggregates may block the filter and affect filter capacity

blocks.zh: CDMO 接新生物製劑客戶時，過濾相容性研究通常是最複雜且最耗時的驗證活動之一，需要在工藝開發階段早期就開始。
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on a new biologic customer, the filter compatibility study is usually one of the most complex and time-consuming validation activities, and it needs to start early in process development.

blocks.zh: 一個 mAb 製劑含有抑菌特性，無法直接用 B. diminuta 做挑戰測試。請說明至少兩種可行的替代方案，並各自的優缺點。
blocks.en: A mAb formulation has bacteriostatic properties and cannot be challenged directly with B. diminuta. Describe at least two feasible alternatives, with the advantages and disadvantages of each.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 0.2 µm 過濾器後使用完整性測試失敗（Flow Rate 超限），你應採取哪些行動？此批次產品如何處置？
blocks.en: If the post-use integrity test of your 0.2 µm filter fails (flow rate out of limit), what actions should you take? How should this batch be dispositioned?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ISO 13408-2 要求使用「不少於三批過濾器（three lots）」進行驗證，而不是只用一批過濾器做更多次測試？
blocks.en: Why does ISO 13408-2 require validation with "no fewer than three filter lots" rather than running more tests with only one filter lot?

blocks.zh: Clauses 10–12: Routine Monitoring, Product Release, and Process Maintenance Clauses 10–12：例行監測、產品放行與製程維護
blocks.en: Clauses 10–12: Routine Monitoring, Product Release, and Process Maintenance

blocks.zh: 核心概念：完整性測試失敗 = 批次拒絕？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Integrity Test Failure = Batch Rejection?

blocks.zh: 第 11.2 條的規定非常重要：後使用完整性測試（Post-Use Integrity Test）失敗，原則上批次必須拒絕。
blocks.en: The provision in Clause 11.2 is very important: if the post-use integrity test fails, the batch must in principle be rejected.

blocks.zh:
例外情況（難以接受）：
必須能夠「證明失敗不是由於過濾器微生物攔截不足引起的」——實際上幾乎不可能做到，因為你無法在事後用非破壞性方法測試微生物是否通過了。
blocks.en:
Exceptions (hard to accept):
You must be able to "demonstrate that the failure was not caused by inadequate microbial retention of the filter". In practice this is almost impossible, because you cannot use a non-destructive method after the fact to test whether microorganisms passed through.

blocks.zh: 實務上，完整性測試失敗是批次拒絕的充分條件。這也說明了 PUPSIT 的商業價值：在充填前就發現問題，避免充填了整批產品後才發現。
blocks.en: In practice, an integrity test failure is a sufficient condition for batch rejection. This also illustrates the commercial value of PUPSIT: finding a problem before filling avoids discovering it only after the whole batch has been filled.

blocks.zh: 過濾變更評估矩陣 Change Assessment Matrix
blocks.en: Change Assessment Matrix

blocks.zh:
變更類型              | 需要重新驗證？ | 備考
─────────────────────────────────────────
配方成分改變           | 可能需要      | 評估對黏度、pH、微生物特性影響
原料藥濃度 ±10%        | 可能需要      | 評估對過濾能力和浸出物的影響
pH 值偏移             | 可能需要      | 影響 B. diminuta 細胞大小
過濾器孔徑規格改變      | 必須重新驗證   | 整個驗證需重做
過濾器換不同供應商      | 必須重新驗證   | 新供應商的膜材可能不同
同供應商新批次（生命週期）| 年度監控即可  | 完整性測試數據趨勢分析
過濾系統 SIP 程序改變   | 重新評估      | 評估滅菌效果和對濾膜的影響
生產批量大幅增加        | 可能需要      | 評估過濾器面積是否足夠
blocks.en:
Change type                       | Revalidation needed?  | Remarks
─────────────────────────────────────────
Formulation component change      | Possibly              | Assess impact on viscosity, pH, microbial characteristics
API concentration ±10%            | Possibly              | Assess impact on filter capacity and leachables
pH shift                          | Possibly              | Affects B. diminuta cell size
Filter pore size specification    | Revalidation required | Entire validation to be repeated
Change of filter supplier         | Revalidation required | New supplier's membrane material may differ
New lot from same supplier (life cycle) | Annual monitoring is sufficient | Trend analysis of integrity test data
Filtration system SIP procedure   | Reassess              | Assess sterilization effect and impact on membrane
Significant increase in batch size | Possibly             | Assess whether filter area is sufficient

blocks.zh: 重要提示：批次可追溯性要求
blocks.en: Key Point: Batch Traceability Requirements

blocks.zh: 第 10.2 條要求每次生產過濾必須可追溯至：
blocks.en: Clause 10.2 requires that every production filtration be traceable to:

blocks.zh: 具體的過濾設備（序號）
blocks.en: The specific filtration equipment (serial number)

blocks.zh: 過濾器批號（Lot Number）
blocks.en: The filter lot number

blocks.zh: 設備資格確認狀態
blocks.en: Equipment qualification status

blocks.zh: 使用前後的過濾器狀況（完整性測試數據）
blocks.en: Filter condition before and after use (integrity test data)

blocks.zh: 過濾期間的環境數據
blocks.en: Environmental data during filtration

blocks.zh: 這些記錄構成批次放行決策的核心證據鏈。在任何批次調查或 regulatory inspection 中，這些記錄都會被詳細審查。
blocks.en: These records form the core evidence chain for the batch release decision. In any batch investigation or regulatory inspection, they will be reviewed in detail.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：冗餘過濾器設計策略
blocks.en: Practical Application: Redundant Filter Design Strategy

blocks.zh: 高風險應用（如生物製劑、高價值批次）中，常見的過濾器設計策略：
blocks.en: Common filter design strategies in high-risk applications (e.g. biologics, high-value batches):

blocks.zh: 串聯（Series/Redundant）：兩個 0.2 µm 過濾器串聯，其中一個是備用（redundant）。如果主過濾器完整性測試通過，備用過濾器的測試不是必需的。但如果主過濾器失敗，可以檢查備用過濾器的狀態——但這需要在驗證中預先定義好判斷策略。
blocks.en: Series (redundant): two 0.2 µm filters in series, one of which is a redundant backup. If the integrity test of the primary filter passes, testing the redundant filter is not required. If the primary filter fails, the status of the redundant filter can be checked, but the decision strategy must be defined in advance in the validation.

blocks.zh: 生物負荷削減過濾器：在滅菌過濾之前加一個 0.22 µm 生物負荷削減過濾器（bioburden reduction filter），減少終端過濾器的挑戰量，延長過濾能力。這個「前置過濾器」不需要與滅菌過濾器相同的驗證要求。
blocks.en: Bioburden reduction filter: a 0.22 µm bioburden reduction filter is placed upstream of the sterilizing filter to reduce the challenge to the final filter and extend filter capacity. This "prefilter" does not need the same validation requirements as the sterilizing filter.

blocks.zh: 在冗餘過濾系統（redundant filtration）中，若主過濾器的後使用完整性測試失敗，而備用過濾器通過，此批次是否可以放行？你的決策依據是什麼？需要哪些文件支持？
blocks.en: In a redundant filtration system, if the post-use integrity test of the primary filter fails but the redundant filter passes, can the batch be released? What is the basis for your decision, and what documentation is needed to support it?

blocks.zh: 一個原本驗證在 20°C 進行的過濾製程，現在計劃改為 4°C 冷鏈條件下過濾（為保護熱敏感產品）。這個溫度變更是否需要重新驗證？需要重新評估哪些具體方面？
blocks.en: A filtration process originally validated at 20°C is now planned to be run under cold-chain conditions at 4°C (to protect a heat-sensitive product). Does this temperature change require revalidation? Which specific aspects need to be reassessed?

blocks.zh: 本部分重點回顧 Part 2 Summary
blocks.en: Part 2 Summary

blocks.zh: 本質限制：無菌過濾不適用 SAL，可靠性依賴驗證（細菌挑戰測試）+ 每批完整性測試，不是理論計算
blocks.en: Inherent limitation: sterilizing filtration does not use an SAL; its reliability depends on validation (bacterial challenge test) + integrity testing of every batch, not on theoretical calculation

blocks.zh: 標準挑戰菌：0.2 µm 用 B. diminuta (ATCC 19146)，0.1 µm Mycoplasma 過濾用 A. laidlawii，最低挑戰量 10⁷ CFU/cm²，需3批過濾器、3次連續成功
blocks.en: Standard challenge organisms: B. diminuta (ATCC 19146) for 0.2 µm, A. laidlawii for 0.1 µm Mycoplasma filtration, minimum challenge 10⁷ CFU/cm², 3 filter lots and 3 consecutive successes required

blocks.zh: PUPSIT：EU GMP Annex 1 強制要求，ISO 13408-2 支持；省略需有書面風險評估；操作本身需驗證不引入污染
blocks.en: PUPSIT: mandatory in EU GMP Annex 1 and supported by ISO 13408-2; omitting it requires a documented risk assessment; the operation itself must be validated so that it does not introduce contamination

blocks.zh: 完整性測試失敗 = 批次拒絕（原則上）：後使用測試失敗的批次不能放行，除非有幾乎不可能提供的反證
blocks.en: Integrity test failure = batch rejection (in principle): a batch with a failed post-use test cannot be released unless counter-evidence is provided, which is almost impossible

blocks.zh: 相容性研究：化學相容性 + 浸出物/萃出物 + 吸附，對生物製劑尤其關鍵；需使用實際生產流體
blocks.en: Compatibility studies: chemical compatibility + leachables/extractables + adsorption, especially critical for biologics; the actual production fluid must be used

blocks.zh: 變更管理：配方、設備、過濾器規格的任何重大變更都可能需要重新驗證，供應商必須依品質協議通知
blocks.en: Change management: any significant change in formulation, equipment or filter specification may require revalidation, and the supplier must notify changes per the quality agreement
